description: The Cosmic Scribe is a solo storytelling project for NASA's "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge. Using NASA's open data, this project transforms raw telemetry and logs from inactive rovers and probes on Mars and the Moon into immersive digital chronicles. Designed for school-age enthusiasts, it crafts a 240-second video narrative tracking the history and legacy of these lonely machine pioneers. Based in Dhaka, it focuses on high-impact minimalism and data-driven storytelling.
